ci, iwyu: Request IPC file generation explicitly

Fixes a part of https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/35361.

events.body: Rebased on top of the merged bitcoin/bitcoin#34995.

Code review ACK a31eb8bfa41262528cc4c5a1f9cd46c826597552. Thanks for the updates! This is a minimal fix getting rid of IWYU "fatal error" output from IPC files in the iwyu CI job.

Confirmed fix works by searching for "fatal error" in iwyu [logs](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/actions/runs/30917947684/job/92020774181?pr=35468) and confirming the only instances remaining are `fatal error: 'node/data/ip_asn.dat.h' file not found` and lines like `fatal error: 'mp/proxy.capnp.h' file not found` are gone.

Previous [suggestion](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35468#discussion_r3364500997) to not [prepend](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/aed80c739581d7410461fdbcd1c55e4d6418d177/ci/test/03_test_script.sh#L127) "all" here and have CI jobs to specify "all" if they want it still seems like a good code simplification, but it could be a followup.

ACK a31eb8bfa41262528cc4c5a1f9cd46c826597552


The custom targets seem fine give the limitations of CMake `codegen` currently as ryanofsky explains.

Confirmed the targets built successfully.

In commit "ci, iwyu: Request IPC file generation explicitly" (f83600137cf6926790417338adecf52fac208eaf)

Might be better to do:

```bash
if [[ "${GOAL}" != all && "${GOAL}" != *codegen* ]]; then
```

to avoid needing to reference the IWYU tool here or limit this specifically to IWYU.

Also IMO it would be nicer to just never prepend "all" here and make require CI jobs to specify "all" if they want it.

comments.body:
re: https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35468#discussion_r3535814362

> Looking at both of those threads, there doesn't seem to be any real conclusions about what should be done, or if upstream changes will/should be made?

Yeah, it seems to me the design of cmake's `codegen` target is pretty flawed, and there don't seem to be good suggestions about how to improve it. Cmake's `codegen` target basically has the same problem as its `test` target (https://github.com/bitcoin-core/libmultiprocess/pull/204#issuecomment-3250949821) in that cmake fails to provide granular control over what these built-in targets build, and falls back on `EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL` as a hack to avoid building unnecessary things by default. In the cmake issue, brad.king confirmed "codegen is a subset of all" is intended behavior, and pointed out that the suggested fix (making codegen generate everything the compilation database needs) would let one generated file at the end of an excluded dependency chain drag the whole chain into codegen. Even if cmake changed this, it wouldn't necessarily help here, since the mptest sources are generated by capnproto's `capnp_generate_cpp` function, which doesn't pass CODEGEN (https://github.com/bitcoin-core/libmultiprocess/issues/284).

IMO the limitations of cmake's `codegen` and `test` targets are reasons to avoid depending on them and to prefer more flexible custom targets instead. Custom targets allow building what's needed regardless of what is in `all` or whether third party cmake functions have adopted CODEGEN.
